title: pytest-bdd skill (agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd)
item: pytest-bdd skill: turn a new-format agent spec into BDD tests that gate a built agent, built on the cafe example first
motivation: A built agent needs a gate that checks it against the spec's rules; writing those tests spec by spec without a skill does not scale; and the work feeds findings back into agent-spec
notes: Plan: tasks/plans/001.md (draft of 2026-11-16, not yet approved by the owner). Five slices, each to become its own task file: A three cafe scenarios end to end, with a measurement on a throwaway real LLM agent; B all of the cafe; C broken variants written by a different builder that has not seen the rule checkers; D write the skill from the cafe work; E blind run of the skill in a fresh session. This task stays open as their parent and closes when E passes. Riskiest assumption, agreed with the owner 2026-11-16: tests proven on a scripted agent also work on a real LLM agent. Slice A measures it. A real agent is gated 'from the tested moment': the scripted agent's turns are replayed as history and the real agent takes one turn (the owner's idea). Whole conversations with a real agent are measured, not gated, and belong to tasks 9 and 19. Superseded: the earlier build order (fake order system, grader primitives, S01, S12, S20, S26, S41) was for the old spec format and the order-cancel example.
source_chat: Pytest-bdd verification for agent-spec (Nov 1); Order-support agent login design (Nov 5–6)
done_means: The agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd skill turns a new-format spec into feature files, written by a script with every word copied from the spec, and a test harness. On the cafe example the reference agent passes every test, and each broken variant, written by a builder that did not see the rule checkers, fails the Then sentence of the rule it breaks. A drift check stops the test run when a scenario changes in the spec. Every test can also run with a real LLM agent taking over at the tested moment; in slice A at least 32 of 36 such runs reached a verdict. A fresh session using only the skill reproduces all of this for the cafe spec.
draft_note: Rewritten by Claude in chat on 2026-11-16 at the owner's request, from the plan in tasks/plans/001.md. done_means and verified_by are drafts until the owner approves the plan. Owner decided 2026-11-15: build on the cafe new-format spec first. Branch add-agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd holds earlier work for the old format, not reviewed and not built on.
